rules: Source of truth for build progress. LLD.html is regenerated from this file by `python tools/sync_docs.py`.
Work strictly in order of dependencies; take the lowest-numbered step whose depends_on are all done.
A step is 'done' only when every command in verify passes and the definition of done holds. Record evidence in notes.
progress_pct is the share of the step's checklist items completed (0-100).
Log any design change in DECISIONS.md and update the registry/HLD/LLD before continuing.

Gaps: no dedicated Neo4j read-only user until OD-003 (demo hosting, before BS-32); p95 is server time (network round trip to AuraDB not included); KG tests take ~100 s over the network.

steps.title: Ingestion pipeline (parse, chunk, embed, index)
steps.goal: Job-based ingestion: parsers for MD/TXT/PDF/DOCX, heading-aware chunker that keeps tables and error-code sections whole, embeddings, FTS vectors, document versioning and supersede logic; seed all KB docs.
steps.notes: OD-004 closed (D-024): Vertex text-embedding-005, 768 d. Parsers MD/TXT/DOCX/PDF; heading-aware chunker; embedding batches of 64; Postgres job queue (SKIP LOCKED, 3 attempts, backoff via migration 0004 jobs.run_after); worker job loop; supersede logic. tests/unit/test_chunker.py: 16 passed (no table split, each of the 44 manual error-code sections = exactly one chunk, anchors, packing rules, DOCX/PDF parsing). tests/integration/test_ingest.py: 10 passed on mcs_test with fake embeddings (15 docs via jobs, warranty v1 superseded/v2 active, idempotent re-seed, upload of SB-2026-12 searchable in < 60 s, new version supersedes old, retry/backoff/fail, SKIP LOCKED). `make seed-kb` on dev db with live Vertex (asia-south1): 15 docs, 106 kb_chunks (all 768-d embeddings), 109 FAQ variants embedded, 19.5 s. Semantic spot check: 'my dryer shows dew point high' -> DOC-MAN-DHD#e04-dew-point-high; 'warranty kitna hai' -> FAQ-001 (0.91). Full suite 92 passed. D-023. Gaps: POST /v1/admin/documents route lands with staff auth in BS-26 (FR-KB-01 stays in_progress; live upload timing not yet measured end-to-end through the API); extract_graph + cache invalidation in BS-28/BS-09; 'PM visits in comprehensive AMC' ranks a neighbouring AMC chunk first — hybrid + rerank in BS-08.

steps.title: Hybrid retrieval, filters and reranking
steps.goal: retrieval/hybrid.py: FTS + pgvector with RRF, metadata filters (status, doc_type, family, model), version awareness, cross-encoder reranker behind an interface.
steps.notes: OD-005 closed (D-025): local ONNX cross-encoder Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 (fastembed), baked into the agent image. app/retrieval/hybrid.py: OR-lexeme FTS leg + pgvector leg (k=30 each, embedding concurrent with FTS) → RRF k=60 → rerank top 20 → k_ctx 6; filters status/doc_type/family/model; superseded docs only on past cues; rerank timeout/error keeps RRF order. tests/integration/test_retrieval.py: 8 passed (+3 unit in test_retrieval_unit.py; full suite 109 passed). `make eval-retrieval` on dev db (live Vertex embeddings): filtered+rerank single_hop Recall@5 1.0 (unfiltered 1.0), section MRR 0.979 vs 0.896 without rerank (unfiltered 0.958 vs 0.910); doc MRR 0.979 vs 1.0; FAQ Recall@5 0.914 vs 0.929, MRR 0.810 vs 0.815; version_trap cites v2 never v1; 'old warranty policy before 2025' pulls v1; 0 other-family manual chunks under a model filter. Report eval/reports/retrieval.json. Gaps: rerank latency p50 445 ms / p95 464 ms for 20 pairs on 8 local cores, over the chat rerank budget (250 ms), so chat falls back to RRF order until BS-32 sizing/perf tuning (fewer pairs or shorter max_length); Dockerfile model bake not yet exercised by a deploy build; rerank gives no gain on FAQ-style questions.

steps.title: Entity linking and guarded Text2Cypher
steps.goal: kg/linker.py (dictionary -> full-text -> embedding) and kg/text2cypher.py with schema validation, write-clause rejection, LIMIT injection, timeout, read-only session.
steps.notes: app/kg/linker.py (dictionary -> Neo4j full-text -> embedding) and app/kg/text2cypher.py (guard, schema prompt with 6 few-shots, entity $parameters, READ transaction, 2 s timeout, one repair). tests/unit/test_linker.py: 16 passed — linking accuracy 123/123 = 1.0 on the 54 multi_hop items (gold: model, error code, warehouse, AMC plan from gold_kg_path; FR-KG-02 needs >= 0.95), family disambiguation, ambiguity on PHASE/E06 without context, cue/case rules, fallback order. tests/security/test_text2cypher_guard.py: 52 passed — 23 write/admin attacks rejected (incl. comment, UNION, subquery, apoc function, LOAD CSV, USE system), schema escapes and unbounded paths rejected, LIMIT injected/clamped, rejected queries never reach the DB, one repair; on AuraDB a MERGE run directly in the READ transaction fails at the database and the 2 s timeout fires on a heavy query. tests/integration/test_linker_kg.py: 2 passed (linker from the live graph, Lucene-escaped full-text). CI now runs tests/security too. Full suite 179 passed. D-026. Gaps: NFR-SEC-03 also traces to BS-31 (security hardening); no dedicated Neo4j read-only user until OD-003; Text2Cypher not yet exercised with the real strong model (BS-14/BS-30); embedding fallback threshold (0.6) untuned on real embeddings.

T-COVER returns all top-tied causes (D-027; CHL-A05 pump vs flow switch at 35%), KG template tests updated. Full suite 187 passed. Gaps: planner is rule-based (router intents arrive in BS-13); evidence not yet consumed by an answerer (BS-14/BS-15); no latency budget wiring yet (BS-11 orchestrator).
